events.title: Robotics Workshop: Presented by Power Beans Foundation

cases.refreshed: In this full-day workshop with the Power Beans Foundation, participants will learn the principles of robot design and engineering, along with teamwork and collaboration skills. Teams will build VEX V5RC robots, program them with VEXcode, and showcase them in a friendly competition near the end. Requirements: Lunch is scheduled in the middle from noon to 12:30 p.m. Please bring your own lunch. A signed waiver will be required before participating in this program. Copies will be emailed and available upon arrival. Participants must be ages 10 and up. Registration is required. Registered participants will receive a detailed agenda. Registration opens November 4, 2026, at 9 a.m.
